items.title: 欧盟委员会初步认定元宇宙平台公司调整政策后仍违规
items.raw_excerpt: 欧盟委员会4月15日发布公报称，已向美国元宇宙平台公司发出补充异议声明，初步认定该公司在调整了限制第三方人工智能（AI）助手接入其旗下即时通信应用程序WhatsApp的相关措施后，仍违反欧盟反垄断规则，拟要求该公司恢复第三方AI助手对WhatsApp的访问权限。（新华社）

title_i18n.zh: 欧盟委员会初步认定元宇宙平台公司调整政策后仍违规
title_i18n.en: The European Commission has preliminarily determined that Meta remains in violation of regulations even after adjusting its policies.
title_i18n.es: La Comisión Europea ha determinado preliminarmente que Meta sigue infringiendo las normas tras ajustar sus políticas.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 欧盟委员会4月15日发布公报称，已向美国元宇宙平台公司发出补充异议声明，初步认定该公司在调整了限制第三方人工智能（AI）助手接入其旗下即时通信应用程序WhatsApp的相关措施后，仍违反欧盟反垄断规则，拟要求该公司恢复第三方AI助手对WhatsApp的访问权限。（新华社）
excerpt_i18n.en: On April 15, the European Commission issued a communiqué stating that it has sent a supplementary statement of objections to the American metaverse platform company, preliminarily determining that the company still violates EU antitrust rules after adjusting measures restricting third-party artificial intelligence (AI) assistants from accessing its instant messaging application WhatsApp. The Commission intends to require the company to restore third-party AI assistants' access to WhatsApp. (Xinhua News Agency)
excerpt_i18n.es: La Comisión Europea emitió un comunicado el 15 de abril, indicando que ha enviado una declaración de objeciones complementaria a la empresa estadounidense Meta Platforms. Se determinó preliminarmente que, incluso después de ajustar las medidas relacionadas con el acceso de asistentes de inteligencia artificial de terceros a su aplicación de mensajería instantánea WhatsApp, la compañía sigue violando las normas antimonopolio de la UE. Se planea exigir a la empresa que restaure el acceso de asistentes de IA de terceros a WhatsApp. (Xinhua)

items.title: 智象未来完成新一轮融资，全力打造下一代原生全模态世界模型
items.raw_excerpt: 近日，国内多模态生成式人工智能公司智象未来（HiDream.ai）宣布完成超5亿元新一轮融资。本轮融资由东方富海、安徽省投资集团旗下的省产业投资公司、峰华资本等新股东联合投资，同时合肥产投、兴泰集团、合肥高投、安徽省人工智能母基金等老股东持续加注。 本轮融资将主要用于智象独创的下一代原生全模态世界模型研发、企业服务智能体的产品建设以及全球市场拓展。在AI视频生成技术与具身智能等新兴科技领域加速融合、共同构建世界模型的背景下，此次融资也意味着资本市场对公司领先的底层大模型技术、创新的产品化能力与前瞻的战略生态布局的进一步认可。   领先的大模型技术 作为专注于AIGC领域研发超过10年的全球顶尖技术团队，智象始终引领着大模型技术的演进，坚持以底层创新驱动公司不断实现超越式发展。 智象的模型能力已多次在国际主流评测体系中获得权威验证：此前，公司开源图像生成模型HiDream-I1在权威评测平台Artificial Analysis榜单中于上线后24小时内迅速登顶，成为首个在该榜单取得领先位置的中国自研生成式视觉模型；同时，公司旗下的图像编辑模型HiDream-E1.1也进入Artificial Analysis图像编辑智能体第一梯队，并在多项指标上超过Flux.1 Kontext等主流模型。相关开源模型目前在全球社区下载量已超过200万次，被誉为图片模型领域的DeepSeek，也被视为中国开源图像模型进入全球第一梯队的重要标志。此外，智象早在2024年5月便上线了全球首个开放使用的视频生成DiT（Diffusion Transformer）架构模型，并即将发布分钟级长视频音画同步模型。 领先技术成绩的背后，是智象持续专注于底层模型架构创新。作为国内最早布局多模态大模型的团队之一，公司率先发布了基于DiT架构的产品vivago.ai，并在全球首次推出全新的“扩散自回归”

excerpt_i18n.en: Recently, the domestic multimodal generative AI company HiDream.ai announced the completion of a new funding round exceeding 500 million yuan. This round was jointly invested by new shareholders including Oriental Fortune Capital, the provincial industrial investment company under Anhui Provincial Investment Group, and Fenghua Capital, while existing shareholders such as Hefei Industrial Investment, Xingtai Group, Hefei High-tech Investment, and the Anhui Provincial Artificial Intelligence Mother Fund continued to increase their stakes. The funds will primarily be used for the research and development of HiDream's original next-generation native full-modal world model, the product development of enterprise service agents, and global market expansion. Against the backdrop of accelerating integration between AI video generation technology and emerging fields like embodied intelligence, jointly building world models, this financing also signifies further recognition from the capital market of the company's leading underlying large model technology, innovative productization capabilities, and forward-looking strategic ecosystem layout. Leading Large Model Technology As a globally top-tier technical team with over a decade of focus on AIGC R&D, HiDream has consistently led the evolution of large model technology, adhering to underlying innovation to drive the company's continuous leapfrog development. HiDream's model capabilities have been authoritatively validated multiple times in international mainstream evaluation systems: previously, the company's open-source image generation model HiDream-I1 rapidly topped the authoritative evaluation platform Artificial Analysis chart within 24 hours of its launch, becoming the first Chinese self-developed generative visual model to achieve a leading position on that chart; simultaneously, the company's image editing model HiDream-E1.1 also entered Art.
excerpt_i18n.es: Recientemente, la empresa china de inteligencia artificial generativa multimodal HiDream.ai anunció la finalización de una nueva ronda de financiación por más de 500 millones de yuanes. Esta ronda fue respaldada por nuevos inversores como Oriental Fortune Capital, la empresa provincial de inversión industrial del Grupo de Inversión de Anhui, y Fenghua Capital, mientras que accionistas existentes como Hefei Industrial Investment, Xing Tai Group, Hefei High-tech Investment y el Fondo Madre de Inteligencia Artificial de Anhui continuaron aumentando su participación. Los fondos se destinarán principalmente a la investigación y desarrollo del modelo mundial nativo multimodal de próxima generación exclusivo de HiDream, al desarrollo de productos de agentes inteligentes para servicios empresariales y a la expansión global del mercado. En el contexto de la acelerada integración de tecnologías emergentes como la generación de video con IA y la inteligencia encarnada para construir conjuntamente modelos mundiales, esta financiación también tiene como objetivo...

items.title: Shouldn't we have an agent.lock file for AI coding agents?
items.raw_excerpt: The article discusses whether AI coding agents should have a lock file mechanism similar to package-lock.json to ensure consistent code generation across different runs, addressing reproducibility concerns in AI-assisted development workflows.

title_i18n.en: Shouldn't we have an agent.lock file for AI coding agents?
title_i18n.zh: 我们是否应该为AI编码代理设置一个agent.lock文件？
title_i18n.es: ¿No deberíamos tener un archivo agent.lock para los agentes de codificación con IA?

excerpt_i18n.en: The article discusses whether AI coding agents should have a lock file mechanism similar to package-lock.json to ensure consistent code generation across different runs, addressing reproducibility concerns in AI-assisted development workflows.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 文章探讨了AI编码代理是否需要类似package-lock.json的锁定文件来确保代码生成的一致性。作者认为这种机制有助于解决AI工具在不同运行中产生不同输出的问题，从而提高开发流程的可重复性和可靠性。

items.title: Teaching AI Agents to Speak Hardware
items.raw_excerpt: AI agents hallucinate when they hit domain-specific silicon knowledge like the Chimera GPNPU. We built an MCP server to address that. Here's what we've learned about where MCP works well and where it gets complicated.

title_i18n.en: Teaching AI Agents to Speak Hardware
title_i18n.zh: 教导人工智能代理掌握硬件语言
title_i18n.es: Enseñar a los agentes de IA a comunicarse con hardware

excerpt_i18n.en: AI agents hallucinate when they hit domain-specific silicon knowledge like the Chimera GPNPU. We built an MCP server to address that. Here's what we've learned about where MCP works well and where it gets complicated.
excerpt_i18n.zh: AI智能体在遇到特定领域的硅知识，如Chimera GPNPU时，会产生幻觉。为此我们构建了一个MCP服务器来解决这一问题。以下是我们在实践中总结出的MCP适用场景及其复杂性所在。
excerpt_i18n.es: Los agentes de IA alucinan cuando se topan con conocimientos específicos de silicio como el GPNPU Chimera. Construimos un servidor MCP para abordar eso. Esto es lo que hemos aprendido sobre dónde funciona bien el MCP y dónde se complica.

items.title: Hacking MCP Servers in AI Systems – The Rug Pull: Tool Changes After Approval
items.raw_excerpt: The article examines security vulnerabilities in MCP servers within AI systems, focusing on 'rug pull' attacks where tools are maliciously altered after approval, potentially compromising system integrity and raising concerns about AI security architecture.

title_i18n.en: Hacking MCP Servers in AI Systems – The Rug Pull: Tool Changes After Approval
title_i18n.zh: AI系统中MCP服务器遭黑客攻击——批准后的工具变更陷阱
title_i18n.es: Pirateando Servidores MCP en Sistemas de IA – El Rug Pull: Cambios en Herramientas Tras la Aprobación

excerpt_i18n.en: The article examines security vulnerabilities in MCP servers within AI systems, focusing on 'rug pull' attacks where tools are maliciously altered after approval, potentially compromising system integrity and raising concerns about AI security architecture.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 文章探讨了AI系统中MCP服务器存在的安全风险，特别是工具在获得批准后被恶意修改的“拉地毯”攻击方式。这种攻击可能破坏AI系统的完整性，引发对AI安全架构的重新审视。
